nodes.text: Of what this man accuses you, of that you are innocent, so
help you God, the God who created heaven and earth,
leaf, flowers and grass, which before was not at all. And
if you swear falsely, may the earth swallow you that
swallowed Dathan and Abiram. And if you swear falsely,
may the leprosy come upon you that left Naaman and
came upon Gehazi. And if you swear falsely, may the
Law destroy you that God gave to Moses on Mount Sinai, which
God himself wrote with his fingers on the stone tablet.
And if you swear falsely, may all the writings fell you
that are written in the five books of Moses. This is the
Jews' oath that Bishop Konrad has given this city.
